title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend — Java / Spring Boot
description: Akatlar, Istanbul · Full-time · Hybrid, primarily office-based Medicasimple is a fast-growing dental practice management software company serving more than 10,000 healthcare professionals across 1,500+ clinics . We help clinics manage their operations, patient journeys, communications, and growth through one connected platform. With an established presence in Türkiye and growing international reach, we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help develop the systems behind our product. You’ll work on software that healthcare professionals use every day, where reliable integrations, accurate data, and secure access have a direct impact on clinic operations. This is a backend-focused role with end-to-end feature ownership . You’ll work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL, collaborating closely with product and QA to understand requirements, make practical engineering decisions, and deliver maintainable solutions. We value curiosity, ownership, clear communication, and thoughtful use of AI. We use AI-assisted tools to accelerate development while taking responsibility for the correctness, security, and quality of what we ship. In this role, you will: Own backend features from requirement clarification and technical design through implementation, testing, and release. Build and maintain REST APIs and business logic supporting clinic operations and patient workflows. Develop reliable integrations with external services through APIs and webhooks, including error handling, retries, and recovery. Design and improve data models, schema migrations, transactions, and queries to support correctness and performance. Implement authentication, authorization, and data isolation across organizations using the platform. Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and write targeted tests to prevent critical problems from recurring. Contribute to code reviews and pragmatic improvements to the existing architecture, balancing delivery speed, reliability, and maintainability. We’d like to hear from you if you have: A Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. At least 4 years of professional software development experience , including delivering and maintaining production applications. Strong backend development skills with Java and Spring Boot , including REST API design and business logic implementation. Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, and JPA/Hibernate , including data modeling, schema migrations, transaction management, and query optimization. Experience integrating external services through APIs and webhooks , with reliable error handling. A good understanding of authentication, authorization, and data isolation in applications serving multiple organizations. Strong computer science and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, software design, and reasoning about correctness and performance. The ability to understand existing codebases, work effectively within an established architecture, and identify practical improvements without unnecessary complexity. Strong debugging skills and experience writing focused automated tests for critical functionality. Confidence working with Git, pull requests, and code reviews , with clear communication in English and effective collaboration with product and QA. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, debugging, and testing, with sound judgment in reviewing generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. Experience in any of the following would be a plus: React and JavaScript/TypeScript , including state management, API integration, and responsive interfaces. Flutter and Dart for iOS and Android applications. Stripe, Twilio, or subscription billing systems . Healthcare software or products supporting clinical and operational workflows. CI/CD pipelines and mobile release workflows. Reporting systems and data import/export processes. React and Flutter are optional strengths for this position. Your primary focus will be backend engineering. At Medicasimple, you’ll have the opportunity to: Take meaningful ownership of features in an established SaaS product used by thousands of healthcare professionals. Contribute to technical decisions and see how your work improves real customer workflows. Help develop a product as it expands across international markets. Build experience with AI-assisted engineering in a production environment that values sound judgment and maintainable software. Be part of a collaborative team with regular team activities, off-site events, and happy hours. Learn and see more -> medicasimple.com/about-us Our team works primarily from our Akatlar office in Istanbul , with flexibility for some remote work. Regular in-person collaboration is part of the role. If you enjoy understanding product problems, making thoughtful engineering decisions, and taking responsibility for what you ship, we’d love to hear from you. Medicasimple is committed to an inclusive workplace and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We evaluate candidates based on their qualifications, skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team.

Levent, Istanbul office. Our Team & Vibe We're a hustle ownership obsessed, hands-on team building in 4. Levent. No dress code, no performative formality; just focused work, fast iteration, and people who care about the craft. Our office is built for focus: quiet corners when you need to go deep, open space when you want to riff with teammates. Unlimited sugar-free and healthy snacks, specialty coffee, and yes, oat milk. We take the "snacks & cozy office" thing seriously. Your ideas ship to production, not into a backlog. Benefits Competitive net salary & private health insurance: We provide clear and reliable financial and health coverage. Learning budget ($100/month): Use it for courses, content, or any resources that support your growth. AI-augmented development workflow: We cover the cost of all AI tools (Cursor,ChatGPT, Claude) you use to improve your productivity. Quarterly team experiences: Thoughtfully designed events that bring the team together. MultiSport membership: Stay active with access to gyms and various sports facilities. Hiring Process HR Interview: 30 min, Google Meet Technical Case: 1 week to complete Online Team Lead Interview: 30 min, Google Meet On-site Technical Interview: ~2 hours at our 4. Levent office Offer We aim to keep the process efficient and stay in touch with candidates moving forward through the interview stages.

title: Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
description: Global girişimcilik ekosisteminin geleceğini birlikte geliştirelim! Büyüyen teknoloji ekibimize, ürün geliştirme süreçlerimizde aktif rol alacak, teknolojiye tutkuyla yaklaşan ve geliştirdiği yazılımla fark yaratmak isteyen bir Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Mevcut web uygulamalarımızın frontend ve backend geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif rol almak, Ölçeklenebilir, güvenli ve sürdürülebilir yazılım mimarileri geliştirmek, FinTech, e-Fatura, ön muhasebe ve ödeme sistemleri alanlarında yenilikçi çözümler geliştirmek, Yerel ve uluslararası üçüncü parti API entegrasyonlarını gerçekleştirmek, Uygulama performansını, güvenliğini ve kullanıcı deneyimini sürekli iyileştirmek, Teknik problemlerin analiz edilmesi ve çözülmesinde sorumluluk almak, Yeni ürün ve özelliklerin fikir aşamasından canlı ortama alınmasına kadar tüm geliştirme süreçlerine katkıda bulunmak. Sende Aradığımız Özellikler En az 2 yıl profesyonel yazılım geliştirme deneyimi, C# ve .NET teknolojilerinde deneyim, Angular ve TypeScript konusunda yetkinlik, MS SQL Server, Azure SQL veya benzeri ilişkisel veri tabanlarında deneyim, RESTful API geliştirme ve entegrasyon süreçlerine hâkimiyet, Git ve modern yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinde deneyim, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve bağımsız çalışma becerisi, Teknik dokümantasyonları takip edebilecek düzeyde İngilizce bilgisi. Seni Öne Çıkaracak Özellikler CQRS mimari deseni ve MediatR kütüphanesiyle deneyim, FinTech, ERP veya muhasebe yazılımları geliştirmiş olmak, Ödeme sistemleri ve finansal API entegrasyonlarında deneyim, Docker, CI/CD süreçleri ve bulut altyapıları konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak, Yapay zekâ destekli yazılım geliştirme araçlarını etkin kullanabilmek. Neden Jestiyon? Uluslararası pazarlara yönelik, kendi teknolojisini geliştiren bir şirketin parçası olma fırsatı, Farklı ülkelerde binlerce girişimcinin kullandığı ürünler üzerinde çalışma deneyimi, Finansal teknolojiler, yapay zekâ ve dijital dönüşüm alanlarında yenilikçi projeler, Teknik karar alma ve ürün geliştirme süreçlerine doğrudan katkı sağlama imkânı, Girişimci, dinamik ve gelişim odaklı bir çalışma kültürü. Yalnızca kod yazmak değil, geliştirdiğin teknolojinin global ölçekte yarattığı etkiyi görmek istiyorsan seni ekibimizde görmek isteriz.
